verdict.rationale: Gitea's managed offering explicitly lets users "Choose your provider and region". The self-hosted edition gives full control over where data lives, because it deploys on your own server via the binary or the official container image. Both paths directly deliver a user choice of storage location. Missing for 10: a documented list of available managed regions, explicit data-residency guarantees or terms, and independent or hands-on corroboration of managed-region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Launch a managed environment for teams that want speed, support, and low operational overhead. Choose your provider and region
Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license. Full control, unlimited users and repositories.
or use container (docker/podman/etc) to deploy on your own server with the official image.
